County FIPS codes for the five New York City counties

Source: R/nyc_counties.R
nyc_county_fips.Rd

Returned as a named character vector. Useful for filtering or validating geoid columns whose first five characters encode the state + county FIPS.

Usage

nyc_county_fips()

Value

A named character vector of length 5.

Examples

nyc_county_fips()
#> New York    Kings   Queens    Bronx Richmond 
#>  "36061"  "36047"  "36081"  "36005"  "36085"
